h2: Blocked Drains & Toilets Sanur – Clear Without Harsh Chemicals
intro: If you're dealing with blocked drains & toilets in Sanur, the cause is often tied to the area's ageing infrastructure and coastal climate. We clear toilet bowls, shower drains, sink lines and sewer pipes using a flexible drain snake — no corrosive chemicals that would wreck your septic tank or brittle PVC joints. Send photos on WhatsApp and you'll get a straight quote based on what we see.

sections.h3: Why Sanur Villas Clog More Often
sections.text: Most homes here were built fifteen to twenty years ago with original PVC pipework that has gone brittle under constant sun exposure. In Sindhu and Semawang, salt-laden sea air accelerates corrosion on tap fittings and pump motors, while brackish well water near the beach builds mineral scale inside heaters and narrow drain lines. The result? A slow shower drain one month, a full blockage the next. Rather than patching a fragile section, we sometimes recommend replacing a short run of pipe so the fix actually lasts.

sections.h3: What We Clear Around Sanur Kaja & Mertasari
sections.text: A toilet that won't flush after a long weekend, a sink that gurgles but refuses to empty, or that persistent sewage smell drifting through the bathroom — these are the calls we hear most often around Sanur Kaja and Mertasari. Because many villas here sit on small septic tanks with narrow connecting pipes, even a handful of wet wipes or a splash of cooking grease can create a stubborn obstruction. We work through the trap with a flexible snake to pull it out cleanly, protecting your tank and downstream pipework from chemical damage.

sections.h3: Send Photos on WhatsApp for a Quote
sections.text: No phone calls, no back-and-forth emails. Open your camera, take two or three clear shots of the affected fixture — the toilet bowl, the overflow under the sink, or the floor drain where water is pooling — plus one wide shot showing the pipe run if visible. Drop those into our WhatsApp chat along with a short note about when the problem started and whether you've tried anything already. You'll get a straightforward quote based on what you send; pricing depends entirely on the job's scope.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Drains Clear in Coastal Sanur
sections.text: A few simple habits help here. Flush only toilet paper — never wipes or food scraps — because small septic systems tolerate very little. Rinse the kitchen sink with cold water after cooking so grease doesn't harden in the pipe. If your villa sits near the beach, wipe down exposed fittings and pump housings monthly to slow salt corrosion. And don't skip septic inspections; an overdue pump-out remains the top cause of recurring smells and slow drains across older Sanur properties.

faq.q: Do you use chemical drain cleaners?
faq.a: No. We work with a flexible drain snake that physically removes the obstruction, which keeps your PVC joints, septic tank bacteria and nearby pipework intact.

faq.q: How do I tell if it's a blockage or a full septic tank?
faq.a: If every fixture in the house is draining slowly at once and there's a strong odour around the tank area, it's more likely an overdue pump-out rather than a single clog. Send us photos and we can point you in the right direction.

faq.q: Do you cover Sindhu, Semawang and Mertasari as well?
faq.a: Yes — our service area spans all of Sanur, from Batujimbar up through Semawang and Sindhu to the beachfront strips, so wherever your villa sits along the coast we can get to you.
